original_test_intent: Update the exact PCIe retimer firmware, activate the staged image through an approved AC cycle, and prove both the new active version and healthy negotiation of every path traversing that retimer.
original_method: Map retimer inventory/serial to upstream/downstream ports and dependent GPUs/switches; baseline active firmware, link speed/width and errors; verify signed compatible image and recovery; perform one approved Redfish upload and follow returned task; operator AC-cycles; validate active version, all connected paths, device enumeration and management/host health.
manual_activity: Platform owner identifies retimer/path and approves image/recovery; operator controls outage and AC cycle; agent is limited to the authorized upload/task/readback workflow.
required_inputs: Retimer inventory ID/serial and full upstream/downstream topology
Signed image/hash, active current/target versions and hardware compatibility
Known-good rollback or vendor recovery for the retimer
BMC target mapping, certificate/credentials, returned-task semantics
Job drain, maintenance, power and console/OOB approvals
safety_requirements: Do not map HGX_0 to a retimer by assumption
Preserve pre-existing error logs and per-link baseline
No AC cycle before terminal staging and explicit operator control
Stop on lost device, degraded link, new AER/error or management failure; never retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and perform one approved Redfish upload
Observe returned task and collect post-AC active version/link evidence
Report faults and recovery without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve retimer/HGX target identity and approve payload/rollback
Authorize flash and AC service interruption

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic nvflash/nvsm lacks retimer identity, source Redfish task semantics and per-path validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Upload only the signed retimer payload to its vendor-mapped Redfish target, follow the returned task, then after operator AC activation read the retimer version and enumerate every mapped link/device with error deltas.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One HGX_0 target and thirty-minute estimate are retained but not treated as retimer mapping or timeout authority.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a topology ledger tying retimer serial and firmware to each upstream/downstream port, link baseline, upload task and post-cold-boot negotiation result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the link fan-out that makes a retimer update functionally meaningful.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct inventory version with degraded or missing downstream paths fails the intended activation validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One retimer failure can hide several GPUs and prevent in-band recovery; BMC/PDU console evidence and vendor recovery must remain available.

project_override_considerations: Board owner supplies retimer enumeration, port map, supported image and acceptable link speed/width/error oracle.
expected_evidence: Retimer serial/inventory ID and port/device topology
Signed image/hash and pre/post active firmware
Operator AC-cycle and console/BMC reconnect record
Every upstream/downstream lspci speed/width/device and AER/error delta

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item is retimer-specific, whereas Procedure exposes only generic DGX inventory and HGX_0, with no retimer or affected-path mapping.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution is gated by ordinary firmware identity, package and approval inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row265 Wistron-NV GPU-00258-V002: identify the exact retimer serial/inventory ID and upstream/downstream topology behind HGX_0; approve signed image, active versions, per-path speed/width/error oracle, Redfish task/activation semantics, rollback and AC-cycle/OOB recovery.

review_improvement: Connects the firmware operation to the retimer's complete PCIe fan-out and requires active-version plus functional path recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A retimer can enumerate only indirectly through a vendor inventory while multiple PCIe paths depend on it. Firmware activation may succeed at the controller yet retrain a downstream link at reduced width or introduce AER faults. Therefore the before/after oracle is topology-wide link health, not just one version property; OOB recovery is essential because a failed retimer may remove the very GPU path used for diagnostics.
